CustomField.description: Renewal opportunities are created on the back of status change on the insurance policy record which is 28 days before renewal date. So at that point all opps will be assigned standard type. 14 days before policy renewal date - the non auto renewals process trigger which gives team 2 weeks to try and reach the customer to confirm the renewal can go through. At this point the field will be updated to non auto. 7 days before when policies are attempted to renewal if payment doesnt go through they will before failed renewals which will trigger a separate process to try and save them. At this point, status is updated to failed renewal.
CustomField.label: Renewal Type
